# Hero Background Image

## Current Status
The hero section is configured to use a background image located at `/images/hero-bg.jpg`.

## To Add a Background Image
1. **Download a suitable AI/tech background image** from:
   https://www.freepik.com/free-photos-vectors/ai-background/2#uuid=357aa474-e006-4be0-88c0-9f494aa318f7

2. **Save the image** as `hero-bg.jpg` in this directory (`static/images/`)

3. **Recommended image specifications**:
   - Format: JPG or PNG
   - Resolution: At least 1920x1080 (Full HD)
   - Theme: Network mesh, AI, technology, abstract tech patterns
   - Colors: Purple, blue, dark themes work best with the current design

## Fallback
If no image is provided, the CSS will fall back to a gradient background.

## Current Network Mesh Image
A beautiful purple/blue network mesh image was provided that perfectly matches the MCP Shell tech aesthetic. This image should be saved as `hero-bg.jpg` to complete the hero section design.
